About AMS Handicrafts

Built on Moradabad's metal-craft tradition

AMS Handicrafts is run by Aamir, working with karigars (craftsmen) across Moradabad who hand-shape, hammer and finish every piece we catalogue. We supply retailers, gifting houses and interior stylists who want handmade pieces at wholesale volumes.

  • 01Every item is hand-finished — no two pieces are perfectly identical.
  • 02Sizes, finishes and set combinations can be customised on request.
  • 03We pack and ship across India and export internationally.
